rows.story_purpose: Set up who the player is, where they are, and why the first pressure arrives.
player_must_understand: The location and immediate social context are clear.
The next choice is not shown yet because stakes are incomplete.

knowledge_boundaries.fact: Character A knows the promise but Character B does not.

narrative_requirements: At least two narration/dialogue beats before the next interaction.
visual_evidence_required: Prop or UI hint supports the key fact.

ui_surfaces_required.purpose: Deliver player context without generating extra video.

mechanics_and_state_changes.effect: Unlocks a memory log entry that can echo before the first choice.

video_requirement.reason: Setup can be handled by text+image.

qa_acceptance: Player can explain where they are and what new fact was introduced.
